title: Use strip option from Rust 1.59
author: wcampbell0x2a
body:
You could replace your strip scripts with the official strip provided in Cargo profiles if you bump MSRV to 1.59.

https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/profiles.html#strip

I'd be happy to try this out, unless you have a MSRV policy that I couldn't find.
